semiconductor_relevance: Medium — KOTRA primarily facilitates trade and investment in the semiconductor sector rather than directly supplying semiconductor products or technologies.
summary: The Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA) supports the global expansion of Korean companies and attracts foreign investment into Korea. At SEMICON Taiwan 2026, KOTRA showcases the latest semiconductor technologies and provides a platform for businesses to explore partnerships with leading Korean firms.
capabilities: Facilitating trade and investment in semiconductor technologies
Connecting global businesses with Korean semiconductor companies

regional_presence.Korea: KOTRA operates 131 overseas offices across 86 countries, promoting Korean semiconductor technologies globally.
